snippet.title: Horologiorum Ancilla Official trailer || Gothic-romantic Nonbinary Yuri VN
snippet.description:
Between the streams of the Rhine river and bustle of the local town, right in front of a cross-adorned hill – there lays a romantic mansion, perfect for you to enter.
Yet, it seems to only be the servantry that is residing within its baroque halls… such as one particular lovestruck Maid that stands out from the crowd – and has been awaiting you eagerly.

Become their Master.

━━━━━━━━⊱༒︎ • ༒︎⊰━━━━━━━━ 

(18+ only)
Horologiorum Ancilla is a serialized & free-to-play mature Gothic Romance Nonbinary Yuri VN made by a university student and the very small team alongside him.  
Fundraiser for voice acting available on the official website below.

✧ FIRST 3 CHAPTERS FOR PC & MAC: 
 ━━━━⊱ https://horologiorum.de 
 ━━━━⊱ https://phantomeros.itch.io/horologiorum-ancilla
 ━━━━⊱ https://jaststore.com/games/phan001/horologiorum-ancilla

────────
Art, script writing: Phantomeros
Music: Makino
Video editing: NekoNat
Audio editing: Stephen Bryson
Voice acting: Kimmie Nguyen | Gawwth | Haden Ezekiel Felix | Phantazmagoriya | Maganda Marie

━━━━━━━━⊱༒︎ • ༒︎⊰━━━━━━━━ 
* No GEN AI was used in the making of the game nor this trailer.

#visualnovel #datingsim #indiegame #yuri #gothic
